hero.paragraph: Packton ni urusobe rw'ubwikorezi rushingiye ku ikoranabuhanga. Turi gukemura ibibazo bikomeye by'ubwikorezi bwa nyuma mu Rwanda dukoresheje ihuzwa ry'imodoka nyazo n'ikoranabuhanga rinoze.
hero.imageAlt: Umukozi wa Packton yohereza umuzigo ava kuri moto ifite ikirango cya Packton mu Kigali

story.paragraph1: Mbere ya Packton, ubucuruzi mu Kigali bwakoranaga n'isoko ry'ubwikorezi ritunganye: gutakaza ibicuruzwa, gutinda kw'amafaranga y'ubwikorezi, no kubura uburyo bwo gukurikirana. Twabonye icyuho, maze tugerageza kugikemura.
story.paragraph2: Ubu, dukoresha uburyo bumwe busanzwe bwo gukora — kuva igihe urutonde rw'ibicuruzwa rushyirwaho kugeza igihe amafaranga agera kuri konti yawe — kugira ngo ubucuruzi bwiyongereze mu bwikorezi nta mpungenge.

pillars.label: Intego
pillars.title: Impamvu Turi Hano
pillars.description: Gukuraho ingorane mu bwikorezi, guha buri bucuruzi mu Rwanda — kuva ku mucuruzi umwe kugeza ku muhuza w'igihugu hose — umufatanyabikorwa mu bwikorezi bashobora kwizera igihe cyose.

pillars.label: Icyerekezo
pillars.title: Aho Tugana
pillars.description: U Rwanda aho intera itagira aho ibuza amahirwe — aho ubucuruzi ubwo ari bwo bwose bushobora kugera ku mukiriya uwo ari we wese, mu karere kose, ufite icyizere kimwe nk'aho ari hafi.

values.heading: Indangagaciro Zacu Nyamukuru
values.paragraph: Amahame agena buri kohereza, buri nzira, n'icyemezo cyose dufata muri Packton.

items.title: Umuvuduko
items.description: Buri saha umuzigo umaze utagenda utera igihombo abafatanyabikorwa bacu. Dukohereza vuba kandi dutanga ibicuruzwa vuba, kugira ngo ubucuruzi bwawe butarindira.

items.title: Ukuri
items.description: Kuva aho ufatirwa kugeza aho usinyirwa, buri ntambwe irakurikiranwa kandi igaragara. Nta gutekereza aho umuzigo uri — kuri wowe, cyangwa ku muntu uwutegereje.

items.title: Byubatswe Kugira ngo Bikure
items.description: Imizigo cumi ku kwezi cyangwa igihumbi ku munsi — imodoka zacu n'uburyo bwacu bikura hamwe n'ubucuruzi bwawe nta ngorane.

items.title: Umukiriya ku Mwanya wa Mbere
items.description: Inyuma ya buri kohereza haba hari umuntu utegereje. Dufata buri muzigo, na buri wakira, hamwe n'ubwitonzi tuzifuza ku byacu bwite.
